name: io.github.cybersmurf/stalwart-mail-mcp
description: Mail and contacts on a self-hosted Stalwart server via JMAP: search, read, OCR, send, drafts.

environmentVariables.name: STALWART_URL
environmentVariables.description: Public address of the Stalwart server, e.g. https://mail.example.com

environmentVariables.name: STALWART_USER
environmentVariables.description: Mailbox e-mail address to sign in with

environmentVariables.name: MAIL_LANG
environmentVariables.description: Language: auto, en, cs, de, es, fr, it, nl, pl, pt, sk

environmentVariables.name: MAIL_OCR_PROVIDER
environmentVariables.description: OCR of scans: auto, off, mistral, anthropic, openai, openrouter, gemini, ollama, lmstudio, custom

environmentVariables.name: MAIL_OCR_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key of the OCR provider (not needed for local servers)

environmentVariables.name: MAIL_OCR_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Address of a custom OpenAI-compatible OCR server
